tasks.short: Build rapport and reflect with clients

steps.what: Talk with clients to build rapport and reflect on reactions to the artistic process

tasks.design: Retain therapeutic dialogue and rapport building with the art therapist. {DOCS} may hold existing plans, while the live relationship remains fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reflection depends on trust and the client's own meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: No substitution of therapeutic interaction is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Responding sensitively without imposing an interpretation.

reach.learn: How to support reflection without leading the client

evidence.claim: Documentation support does not establish shorter rapport-building or therapeutic reflection.

assumptions: Direct conversation only; report writing is separate.
No automatic emotion or progress classifications.
research_questions: Which interactions require more time for client-led reflection?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Therapeutic dialogue retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write treatment plans, summaries and progress reports

steps.what: Select verified observations, client goals and treatment decisions for reports
Write treatment plans, case summaries and progress reports from verified material

loop.purpose: Compose documentation expressing therapist-supplied observations and decisions
loop.output: Source-linked draft with missing content marked
loop.check: Therapist checks attribution, uncertainty, goals, progress statements and treatment wording against the brief
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported content is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Individual narrative varies beyond fixed field merging

steps.what: Verify clinical meaning and accept the exact final therapy document version

tasks.design: Use an authorised {DOCS} template and bounded drafting from therapist-verified material. The therapist supplies treatment decisions and checks the exact final wording; no artwork interpretation or progress inference is delegated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical documentation requires repeated narrative composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinician-validated documentation tools provide adjacent drafting capability, requiring validation for art-therapy records.
tasks.still_hard: Separating client meaning, observed behaviour and clinical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The therapist understands the relationship and the limits of an interpretation.
tasks.altitude: More attention to accurate therapeutic documentation

reach.learn: How sources and corrections should remain traceable

evidence.claim: Autoscriber supports clinician-validated documentation; this is adjacent capability and does not establish valid interpretation of art or automatic art-therapy plans.
The proposed report-drafting saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Assessment and session-design tasks own substantive needs and treatment decisions; this task records them without claiming those hours again.

In s1 the therapist captures client/group identity, date, source/author, factual observation, attributed client words, supplied goals/decisions and uncertainty. Capture and source checks retain 30%; missing information is completed manually.
Use authorised native clinical templates and drafting features before custom code. No automatic image interpretation, diagnosis or emotional-state score.
No external disclosure or raw artwork upload is assumed; local processing access requires confirmation.
research_questions: Does drafting save time after complete source and clinical verification?

incremental.description: Template maintenance and additional quality checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact client/group, document text, source attributions, goals and decisions; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross=12%; minus 6 focal upkeep gives net 6%. Range 0-2% allows extensive rewriting and existing efficient templates; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess client needs through artistic processes

steps.what: Assess client needs using artistic processes and sensitive clinical observation

tasks.design: Retain assessment with the therapist during the artistic process. {DOCS} holds contextual records, while images or artwork are not treated as automatic diagnostic inputs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment depends on process, client meaning and clinical context.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated interpretation of artwork is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding unsupported inference about needs or disorders.
tasks.human_edge: Contextual observation and careful clinical interpretation.

reach.learn: How to qualify interpretations and seek corroboration

evidence.claim: Clinical documentation tools do not validate automatic diagnosis from artistic work.

assumptions: Assessment owns needs interpretation; separate reporting must not count these hours twice.
The therapist produces findings through fully counted observation and discussion; no free structured needs flag.
research_questions: Which interpretations require corroborating clinical evidence?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Assessment retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design therapy sessions around client goals

steps.what: Design art therapy sessions or programs responsive to client goals and needs

tasks.design: Keep session and program design with the therapist using existing {DOCS} resources. The separate documentation task can express chosen decisions, while therapeutic activity selection remains fully counted here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activities must fit the client, relationship and evolving goals.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement of therapeutic design judgement is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing an activity that is appropriate and adaptable.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the client's needs and therapeutic process.

reach.learn: How broader care goals shape session choices

evidence.claim: Drafting a plan does not establish valid automatic selection of therapeutic activities.

assumptions: This task owns substantive session design; report composition is separate.
Client goals are elicited through actual care and checked during counted design; no free readiness flag.
Use existing clinical resources before new tools.
No changed design process means no upkeep.
research_questions: Which client circumstances most often change a planned activity?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; therapeutic design retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Therapeutic relationships with carefully checked documentation support
reach: Discuss clinical interpretation and record clarity with adjacent care professionals
role.ambitious_version: Checked drafts support accurate records while therapeutic meaning and clinical decisions remain with the therapist and client.
